brief.text: Closed-end funds feature prominently across today's activity, with BPRE, SWZ, and PSUS appearing in the cluster tables alongside several individual fund filings. FUL stands out for an unusually broad consensus, where eight distinct insiders combined for $1,123,318 in purchases. BORR recorded the largest cumulative commitment of any company at $57,144,458 across three insiders, while Nippon Life Insurance Co led all individual filings with a $5,591,238 purchase in CRBG.
